#661 · Tiny Robin Pokémon

Fletchling

Normal Flying

Kalos · Generation 6

Fletchling is a Normal/Flying-type Tiny Robin Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 1.7 kg. It evolves into Fletchinder. Its highest base stat is Speed (62), with a base stat total of 278.
